narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (Iran, Israel, Ukraine) escalate beyond controlled tit-for-tat. The shootdown of a US Apache and Iran's asymmetric retaliation threats confirm the market underestimated the probability of sustained conflict, driving flows into safe havens and commodities.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil and gold; short S&P 500 and BTC; overweight US Treasuries.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Premium
narratives.summary: Capital is pricing in a structural oil supply shock as the Strait of Hormuz blockade persists through Q3 2026 per EIA, with Kuwait seeking bypass pipelines. The US SPR release is misread as bearish but actually signals government preparation for sustained disruption, supporting crude prices.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI and Brent futures; long energy equities; short refined product spreads.

narratives.title: Diplomatic Off-Ramp Uncertainty
narratives.summary: Capital is torn between pricing in a potential Iran deal (White House signals progress) and the reality of active kinetic exchanges. This creates whipsaw risk in oil and equities as markets oscillate between escalation and de-escalation narratives.
narratives.trade_implication: Neutral on oil; long volatility via VIX calls; short USD/CHF on any deal headlines.
